SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-27-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF POORSINA, ALI REZA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TAYLOR, DARRYL LEON $1,542.00 PRINCIPAL, $20.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,562.00, DEFENDANT AGREED TO BUY PLAINTIFF'S 2004 NISSAN MURANO SL BUT PLAINTIFF FAILED TO GET THE VEHICLE TO PASS THE SMOG TEST. TRANSFER OF TITLE TO DEFENDANT WAS NEVER COMPLETED. HOWEVER, DEFENDANT WAS GIVEN POSSESSION OF THE VEHICLE, BUT DEFENDANT PARKED IT ILLEGALLY AND IT WAS TOWED. DEFENDANT FAILED TO RECOVER VEHICLE AND IT WAS SOLD BY TOW YARD. COURT FINDS VALUE OF VEHICLE IS $1542 DUE TO FACT ONLY SALVAGED TITLE RECEIVED WHICH IS ABOUT 40% OF BLUE BOOK VALUE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
